Services

The right help for your garden.

A full transformation or a few well-chosen changes. We offer three ways to get started, with a clear scope agreed before any work begins.

01 / Full garden design

A fresh start, with a clear plan.

For a new garden or a space that needs a complete rethink. We bring the layout, materials and planting together in one considered design.

Design fees from £2,400

Explore this service
02 / Planting design

More life, in every season.

For a garden with a layout you like, but planting that could work harder. We choose plants for your soil, light and the amount of time you want to spend caring for them.

Planting plans from £650

Explore this service
03 / Garden consultation

A useful second pair of eyes.

For a specific problem, a smaller garden or a first step before committing to a full design. We help you decide what to keep, what to change and where to begin.

90-minute visit · £195

Explore this service

Prices are illustrative design fees for this fictional studio. Each real project would need its own written scope and quotation.
